# The Trinetraa

> The Trinetraa is a digital marketing agency for manufacturers in India, run by Sujal Rawal. It helps manufacturing and B2B companies generate qualified enquiries, improve search visibility (SEO and AEO) and build a trusted online presence.

## Services
- Meta Ads: lead campaigns on Facebook and Instagram for B2B manufacturers
- Google Ads: search campaigns that reach buyers actively looking for products and suppliers
- SEO and AEO: visibility on Google and in AI-powered search and answer engines
- LinkedIn Marketing: authority building and reach among B2B decision-makers
- Content and Social Media: product, factory and expertise content
- Branding: identity, catalogues and exhibition material
- Website development and management

## Pages
- [Home](https://thetrinetraa.com/): services, SEO and AEO explainer, results, pricing, ROI calculator, marketing health check and FAQ
